exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery vs. C-section)
cohort: One hundred fifty-two women were included, randomly divided into two groups based on whether they underwent vaginal delivery or C-section, and received a CuT-380A intrauterine contraceptive device.
finding: Postpartum intrauterine contraceptive devices (CuT-380A) are safe, effective, and convenient contraceptive interventions in both vaginal and C-section deliveries.
mod_finding: The vaginal delivery group had more pregnancies and discontinuance after postpartum IUD insertion compared to the C-section group, while the C-section group had more expulsions.
